summary:
Plan of w109 written: plan.md in the stage directory.
Accepted: supervision r1, r20, r59, r60, r61, r62, r63; three deprecated scenarios retired per the work-item's Retires (lines 8, 395, 429).
Decisions: one pool of workers for every stage capped at a top-level `workers` key in .shop/delivery.toml (default 4); delivery.toml read once up front, malformed -> r10 error (fixes D1); transcript_path in each stage's session.json incl. branch review (r49 names it a stage); blocked_by guard in the pool's choice of items; faults drain in-flight stages; merges queued in implementer end order; shared state under one lock.
New modules: scripts/supervise_pool.py (supervise.py has 37 lines of room) and tests/scenarios/supervision_parallel_steps.py; CLAUDE.md row updated.
Tests broken: only the retired scenarios and the two Then steps only they use. Faults/review step modules not verified by research; implementer runs the supervision suite.
Open cases: no transcript found; blocked_by naming nothing/withdrawn/cycle and the exit then; stub count semantics; slot fill order; simultaneous ends.
